answer: A mechanism that actually bites: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because crystal only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, lotus is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any vine approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
